name: ezai-uiux-specialist-persona
description: Audit and upgrade an entire interface through a 6-stage multi-subagent pipeline: detection, audit (usability, accessibility, visual direction), planning with a human gate, generation of the conformance fixes via ezai-uiux-expert, validation, and routing of the remaining visual work to the UI skills installed.

capabilities.description: Full audit: usability heuristics, WCAG conformance, and visual direction
Prioritized fix plan with severity levels and a human gate
Apply the conformance fixes via ezai-uiux-expert, with a bounded validation loop
Route the remaining visual work to the UI skills installed, with the prompt for each
